product_metadata.title: Bamboo Tea Bag Organizer, 3 Tier Vertical Tea Organizer, Tea Holder for Kitchen Island, Coffee Shop Or Office, Tea Storage with 12 Adjustable Partitions (Self-Assembly)
features: RENEWABLE PREMIUM BAMBOO: This tea bag organizer is gathering selected high quality bamboo (phyllostachys pubescens) material in the mountains. It is sturdy, elegant and durable to last for years. All surfaces are covered with food safety coatings to ensure our tea bag holders are smooth without burr-free.

SPACE SAVE: The trapezoidal tea holder can be used to eliminates clutter and free up more storage space on counter top. Open vertical storage provides quick and easy access to tea bags and keeps them within reach while brewing, so you don't have to rummage through drawers for them.

LARGE CAPACITY: The tea organizer for tea bags adopts a 3-layer vertical structure design with 12 compartments, which can hold about 280 tea bags, providing sufficient space to display tea classification.

ADJUSTABLE DIVIDER: Our tea bag storage comes with 9 divider for easy adjustment of the interior space, which can hold your different sizes of tea bags, sugar sachets, stirrers, creamer pods, K cups and instant coffee. The tea bag container can be hung on the wall or can be flexibly placed on any cabinet, countertop, table, kitchen island or patio.

IDEAL TEA BOX: Tea organizer for tea bags measures: 12.1”*8.1”*11.1”. Easy to maintain and clean, just wipe it clean with a damp cloth and mild soap and water. With detailed installation instructions and videos, you can easily assemble it a short time.
